mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM small_group sg JOIN `groups` g ON g.group_id = sg.group_id JOIN region r ON r.region_id = g.region_id JOIN members creator ON creator.member_id = g.member_id

SELECT sg.small_group_id, g.group_id, g.group_name, g.description, r.region_name, g.max_members, sg.like_category, sg.meet_date, sg.location, creator.nickname AS creator_nickname, sg.status FROM small_group sg JOIN `groups` g ON g.group_id = sg.group_id JOIN region r ON r.region_id = g.region_id JOIN members creator ON creator.member_id = g.member_id
ORDER BY g.created_at DESC, sg.small_group_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT sg.small_group_id, sg.status FROM small_group sg JOIN `groups` g ON g.group_id = sg.group_id WHERE sg.small_group_id = #{smallGroupId} AND g.deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
SELECT action FROM restriction_history WHERE small_group_id = #{smallGroupId} ORDER BY restriction_history_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO restriction_history ( member_id, saving_group_id, small_group_id, action, restriction_type, reason, restricted_until ) VALUES ( NULL, NULL, #{smallGroupId}, #{action}, NULL, #{reason}, NULL )
